messages:
Marta Chen: Hey everyone 3 Marta here, joining Platform today from CET. First day! Quick asks: how do I enroll MDM and get VPN set up? Also who to ping for read access to the 'models-playground' GCP project? Fun fact: I collect vintage calculators. Two truths & a lie: ran a half-marathon, speak 5 languages, hate tea. :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Marta! Steps: 1) Accept Okta invite. 2) Use the MDM link in your welcome email and enter the 6-digit code. 3) WireGuard profile auto-provisions after MDM. If you don't get the profile within 10 minutes, reply here.
IT Support: Marta 3 laptop (asset R-7722) shipped. MDM troubleshooting: if "profile installation failed" on mac, run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and reboot. VPN: `brew install wireguard-tools` then import the `.conf` attached to your email and run `wg-quick up redwood`. If `wg-quick` errors, paste the output here (we'll redact IPs).
Liam (Buddy): welcome!! I'll add you to #platform and #new-hires. For GCP, open infra request at https://intranet.redwood/infra-request with project `models-playground` and request `roles/viewer` to start. Tag me and I'll fast-track. Also we have a weekly demo day Friday 3pm CET 3 feel free to present something tiny when you're ready.
Marta Chen: Thanks all 3 small follow-up: how to request a monitor and a standing desk? And where are the starter datasets?
IT Support: Equipment: https://intranet.redwood/equipment-request -> choose "peripherals" -> set priority "new hire". Starter datasets & tiny models in repo `git@github.com:redwood/starter-kits.git` -> `cd starter-kits && make setup && python run_demo.py --model redwood-tiny`. If you hit CUDA OOM, try `export TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128` or run `python run_demo.py --device cpu`.
DevX Bot: account-created: GitHub invite sent, calendar 1:1 with Liam scheduled, Slack channels added.
Marta Chen: Will post intro in #general soon. Fun fact reveal: I actually dislike tea (that's the lie), I do speak some languages, and the vintage calculators are all functional. :nerd_face: :calculator:
